title: The Lord's Compassion and the People's Rebellion
description: A praise of the Lord's grace and great goodness toward the house of Israel. He called them his people and became their Savior. In all their distress, he was also distressed, and the angel of his presence saved them; in love he redeemed them and carried them from ancient times. But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit, so he became their enemy and fought against them himself.
